title: Opening Day
intro: [excited] Cut the ribbon and open the gates, because today is Opening Day! Every clue is about the moment a Disney park, ride or film made its debut. [laughs] Some went great, and some went very, very badly.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A giant red ribbon stretched across ornate theme park entrance gates at sunrise, golden scissors on a velvet pillow, confetti and balloons rising into a clear sky.

categories.title: Ribbon Cutting
categories.intro: First up, Ribbon Cutting! Tell me about the days the Disney parks first opened.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Close view of oversized golden ceremonial scissors cutting a red satin ribbon, a castle softly blurred behind, sunbeams and confetti.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom at Walt Disney World opened on October 1st of this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1971! [excited] Walt Disney World opened with just one theme park and two hotels.

clues.clue: EPCOT Center opened in 1982 on the same date Magic Kingdom opened. What date?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is October 1st! Eleven years to the day after Magic Kingdom.

clues.clue: Disney's Hollywood Studios opened in 1989 under this original name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney-MGM Studios! [chuckles] It got its new name in 2008.

clues.clue: Shanghai Disneyland opened in June of this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2016! [excited] Its castle is the largest Disney castle in the world.

clues.clue: Disneyland's chaotic opening day in 1955 earned this gloomy nickname from employees.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Black Sunday! [sighs] Fake tickets, huge crowds, a heat wave and rides breaking down. It worked out okay in the end.

categories.title: Premiere Night
categories.intro: [excited] Red carpet time! Premiere Night is all about the opening nights of Disney films.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A glamorous 1930s movie palace at night, searchlights sweeping the sky, a red carpet, velvet ropes and a glowing marquee with no lettering.

clues.clue: Disney's first full-length animated feature premiered in December 1937.
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs! [excited] People called it Disney's Folly. Then it was a smash hit.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse's birthday is November 18th because this cartoon opened that day in 1928.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Steamboat Willie! [laughs] Mickey whistling at the wheel of a riverboat.

clues.clue: This 1940 film premiered with a special stereo sound system called Fantasound.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasia! [gasps] Only a few theaters could play Fantasound. It was a very early version of surround sound.

clues.clue: In 1994, The Lion King opened first in two theaters: Radio City Music Hall and this Hollywood movie palace.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the El Capitan Theatre! Disney restored the old Hollywood theater, and it still hosts many Disney premieres.

clues.clue: Snow White premiered at this Los Angeles theater, which is now recreated as a restaurant at Disney California Adventure.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Carthay Circle Theatre! [chuckles] The real theater was torn down in 1969. The California Adventure copy serves dinner.

categories.title: Grand Opening Gallery
categories.intro: [excited] Picture time! These are real photos. Name the place that opened on the date in the clue.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A gallery wall of framed vintage-style theme park photographs and souvenir tickets, a velvet rope in front, warm museum lighting.

clues.clue: This EPCOT icon opened with the park in 1982. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! This photo is from 1983. The ride inside tells the story of human communication.

clues.clue: This giant carved centerpiece opened with Disney's Animal Kingdom in 1998.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tree of Life! [excited] It has over three hundred animals carved into its trunk and roots.

clues.clue: This castle greeted guests on Disneyland's opening day in 1955.
choices: Le Château de la Belle au Bois Dormant
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty Castle! [chuckles] It opened four years before the movie Sleeping Beauty even came out.

clues.clue: When it opened in 1959, this Disneyland mountain was home to the world's first tubular steel roller coaster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Matterhorn Bobsleds! [excited] This photo is from November 1959, the year it opened.

clues.clue: This smoking volcano has stood at the center of Tokyo DisneySea since the park opened in 2001.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mount Prometheus! [gasps] It rumbles and spits fire during the day. Journey to the Center of the Earth runs inside.

categories.title: Now Boarding
categories.intro: Now Boarding! Name the classic attractions from their opening days.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage ride boarding platform with an empty ride boat waiting in glowing blue water, brass railings and hanging lanterns.

clues.clue: This boat ride first opened at the 1964 New York World's Fair before moving to Disneyland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is It's a Small World! [laughs] And now that song will be in your head for the rest of the game. You're welcome.

clues.clue: This roller coaster in the dark opened in Magic Kingdom's Tomorrowland in 1975.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Space Mountain! [excited] It opened in Florida before Disneyland got one in 1977.

clues.clue: This Disneyland boat ride opened in 1967, just months after Walt Disney died. He had worked on it himself.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! [laughs] Yo ho, yo ho. A pirate's life for me.

clues.clue: This trackless Star Wars attraction opened at Disney's Hollywood Studios in December 2019.
clues.answer: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
accept: star wars: rise of the resistance
star wars rise of the resistance
choices: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rise of the Resistance! [excited] Its virtual queue was so popular that it filled up within minutes of the park opening.

clues.clue: Opened in 1963, this Disneyland show was the first attraction to star Audio-Animatronics.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Enchanted Tiki Room! [laughs] Birds sing words and the flowers croon. In the tiki tiki tiki tiki tiki room.

categories.title: Grand Opening Gossip
categories.intro: [chuckles] Our wildcard is Grand Opening Gossip: the behind-the-scenes stories from Disney's big opening days.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage 1950s newsstand with a stack of blank newspapers, a television camera on a tripod and a soft melting asphalt street under a blazing sun.

clues.clue: Disneyland's live opening-day TV special in 1955 had three hosts, including this actor who later became president.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ronald Reagan! [excited] He hosted with Art Linkletter and Bob Cummings, live on ABC.

clues.clue: Walt's older brother waited to retire until Walt Disney World opened, and he dedicated it in October 1971. Who was he?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Roy O. Disney! [sighs] He insisted on calling it Walt Disney World, so everyone would know whose dream it was.

clues.clue: On Disneyland's hot opening day, women's high heels sank into this freshly laid material.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is asphalt! [laughs] It was poured the night before. In the heat, it was basically gooey.

clues.clue: A plumbers' strike meant Walt had to choose between finishing the restrooms or these before Disneyland opened.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is drinking fountains! [chuckles] Walt picked the restrooms. Smart choice, but guests were very thirsty in the heat.

clues.clue: This college student is famous for buying the very first ticket to Disneyland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dave MacPherson! [excited] Ticket number one, from July 18, 1955, the first day open to the public. He paid one dollar to get in.
